# Pholoso Afrika Foundation

> Pholoso Afrika Foundation advances inclusive, adaptive, learner-centred education for neurodivergent children across South Africa and the African continent. Learners should not have to bend to fit rigid systems. The systems should learn to fit the learner.

Every mind learns differently. Education should be built that way.

## Key facts

- A South African registered non-profit company and SARS-approved Public Benefit Organisation.
- Registration: NPO 333-132-NPO · CIPC 2025/951168/08 · PBO 930090077 (Section 18A approved). Qualifying donations can receive a Section 18A tax-deductible receipt.
- Works on three fronts at once: advocacy and awareness; educational innovation with its edtech strategic partner 2to.iQ (https://2toiq.africa); and ecosystem building, connecting the schools, parents, teachers, therapists, researchers and funders around each child.
- Core idea: Understand the learner. Adapt the system. Connect the support.
- Language: person-first by default ("child with autism"); visitors can switch the website to identity-first wording ("autistic child").
- Contact: know@pholoso.africa · https://pholoso.africa/contact/

## Pages

- [Who we are](https://pholoso.africa/about/): mission, vision, six values, the gap in inclusive education, and questions families and funders ask.
- [How we work](https://pholoso.africa/approach/): the three fronts, the Hlompho principle, and how a child's interest opens the curriculum.
- [Stories](https://pholoso.africa/stories/): voices of lived experience and what they ask schools and systems to change.
- [Get involved](https://pholoso.africa/get-involved/): ways for donors, companies and funders, and schools and educators.
- [Donate](https://pholoso.africa/donate/): how to give by bank transfer and request a Section 18A receipt.
- [Resources](https://pholoso.africa/resources/): guides for families and educators (in development).
- [Parent Guide](https://pholoso.africa/parent-guide/): practical ideas for parents, drafts under professional review.
- [Kids' World](https://pholoso.africa/kids/): a calm, child-centred space to play and learn. It collects nothing from children.
- [Privacy notice](https://pholoso.africa/privacy/) · [Accessibility](https://pholoso.africa/accessibility/)
